split.construction: outcome_q.stratify + outcome_q.split_questions, IMPORTED -- 20% of the 19,390 questions held out BY IDENTITY, stratified by channel x popularity decile (20 strata), seed 98765; popularity = train rating count for an item, train answer rate for a concept
split.inner_val: same stratified construction over the TRAIN portion, seed 98765+11

space.adapter_input: [ MEAN-REMOVED k(phi_q) / one global scalar , CHANNEL ONE-HOT (2) ]
space.channel_one_hot: DEVIATION OF RECORD, required by AMENDMENT clause 3: the channel-matched prior-only control ('zeroed prefix + channel one-hot') is only constructible if the channel reaches the adapter separately from the latent. MLP depth/width and the 8 soft prefix tokens are unchanged; the input width moves 128 -> 130.

scramble.what: the twin's correspondence control: a fixed derangement of phrases over vectors across the TRAIN portion (so no held-out phrase can enter training), seed 98765+23, no fixed points
scramble.declared: AMENDMENT clause 3: the permutation is CHANNEL-PRESERVING -- an item vector always receives an item phrase and a concept vector a concept phrase -- so criterion 2 tests correspondence, not channel membership. Asserted at build time.
